hooks.command: f=$(node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(d).tool_input.file_path||"")}catch{}})'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/src/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" ;; esac
